column2:
New year, same laptop. The urge to buy new gear in January is real. But it still works fine.

Resisting.

#RemoteWork

Did a subscription audit. Paying for 12. Actually using 5.

$847 wasted this year on tools I forgot I had.

Classic.

#Productivity

First work day of 2026. Inbox: 847 emails.

Most were newsletters I forgot I subscribed to.

Today's only task: unsubscribe from everything.

#WorkFromHome

Hot take: New Year productivity content is 90% recycled.

Same advice, new date. The basics haven't changed.

Focus. Rest. Repeat.

#Productivity

Tested 5 VPNs over the holidays.

3 dropped connections constantly.
1 was painfully slow.
1 actually worked.

Writing up the comparison now.

#Cybersecurity

January resolution: no more working from bed.

Lasted 3 days last year.

Setting the bar low this time—maybe a full week.

#RemoteWork

Coworking space raised prices again.

Now paying more than my home internet for worse coffee and ambient typing sounds.

The math isn't mathing.

#DigitalNomad

Friend asked for laptop recommendations.

Told him: 16GB RAM, decent battery, good keyboard.

He bought the cheapest one anyway.

Some things never change.

#RemoteWork

Sunday work session.

Just me, coffee, and zero Slack notifications.

This is when the actual thinking happens.

#Productivity

Cleaned my keyboard for the first time in months.

Found a small ecosystem developing under the keycaps.

Highly recommend not waiting this long.

#HomeOffice

Client wants a call at 6am my time. Their 3pm.

Time zones are just a constant source of mild suffering.

#RemoteWork

Password manager saved me again today.

Site I forgot existed got breached. Had a unique password there. Changed it in 10 seconds.

Worth every penny.

#Cybersecurity

Most productive thing I did today: said no to 3 meetings.

Protect your calendar like it's your job.

Because it kind of is.

#Productivity

Webcam quality tip nobody shares:

It's almost never the camera. It's the lighting.

Face a window. Boom. Better than any $200 webcam.

#RemoteWork

Invoice sent: $2,400.
Invoice paid: 47 days later.

NET-30 was the agreement.

Freelance life is just advanced patience training.

#FreelanceLife

Tried Pomodoro again. 25 mins work, 5 mins break.

Worked for exactly 2 days before I forgot about the timer completely.

Some methods just don't stick.

#Productivity

Home office upgrade that actually mattered: a plant.

Not for oxygen or whatever. Just nice to look at something alive during calls.

#HomeOffice

VPN tip: the kill switch matters more than speed.

I'd rather have slow internet than accidentally exposed traffic.

#Cybersecurity

Friday afternoon. Done for the week.

Remote work perk: nobody sees you close the laptop at 3pm.

Weekend starts now.

#WorkLifeBalance

Backed up my files today. Took 20 minutes.

The peace of mind lasts all year.

Do it.

#Productivity

Weekend project: organizing my digital files.

3 hours in and I'm just looking at old photos.

Productivity is a myth.

#RemoteWork

Best purchase of 2025: noise canceling headphones.

Not close.

Changed everything about working from cafes.

#DigitalNomad

Sunday planning session.

Wrote down 3 things to accomplish this week. That's it. Three.

More than that and nothing gets done.

#Productivity

Remote work confession: sometimes I take meetings while walking outside.

Nobody can tell. Fresh air helps me think.

#RemoteWork

Monday morning. Internet is down.

Working from phone hotspot like it's 2015.

Always have a backup connection plan.

#RemoteWork

Project management tools ranked by how often I actually open them:

1. Apple Notes
2. Nothing else

The simple tools win.

#Productivity

Got a phishing email that almost fooled me.

Looked exactly like a real invoice. Only tell: the sender domain was off by one word.

Always check the sender. Always.

#Cybersecurity

Standing desk update: been sitting more lately.

Winter makes standing feel worse somehow.

The $400 desk is currently just a regular desk.

#HomeOffice

Halfway through January.

Checked on my resolutions. They're doing fine without me apparently.

#Productivity

Time tracking revelation: I spend 4 hours a day on actual work.

The rest is meetings, admin, and staring at walls.

Eye-opening.

#Productivity

Client asked why I charge what I charge.

Sent them my expense list.

Suddenly the rate made sense.

Know your numbers.

#FreelanceLife

Two monitors vs one ultrawide.

Tried both. Ultrawide wins for focus. Two monitors wins for multitasking.

Pick based on how you actually work.

#HomeOffice

Friday flex: finished all my work by noon.

Spent the afternoon reading.

This is why I went remote in the first place.

#WorkLifeBalance

Email marketing tool comparison coming soon.

Tested 4 of them. They all do the same thing with different UI.

The price differences are wild though.

#FreelanceLife

Saturday morning and I'm not working.

Progress.

The old me would have opened the laptop by now.

Growth is boring but real.

#WorkLifeBalance

Travel adapter tip: get the universal one.

Carrying 3 different adapters is annoying. One good one covers everywhere.

#DigitalNomad

Planning my first trip of 2026.

Already anxious about working from airports.

Portable charger is non-negotiable.

#DigitalNomad

Best video call setup: one where you can forget about the tech.

Camera works, mic works, done.

Simplicity wins.

#RemoteWork

Monday motivation: there is none.

Just start anyway.

Motivation follows action, not the other way around.

#Productivity

VPN question I get asked most: do you really need one?

Short answer: yes if you use public WiFi.

Otherwise, still probably yes.

#Cybersecurity

Expense tracking saved me $200 on taxes last year.

Just from stuff I almost forgot to deduct.

Worth the 10 minutes a month.

#FreelanceLife

Home office confession: my cable management is a disaster.

Works though.

Nobody sees under my desk on video calls.

#HomeOffice

Mechanical keyboard update: it's loud.

My partner hates it. I love it.

This is a relationship test disguised as a purchase.

#HomeOffice

Two-factor authentication reminder: set it up on everything.

Yes, it's annoying. Yes, it's worth it.

Do it today.

#Cybersecurity

Client communication tip: overcommunicate. Then communicate some more.

Remote work means no hallway conversations. Fill the gap.

#RemoteWork

Invoicing software changed my life.

Used to send Word docs like an amateur.

Now it's automated reminders and actual payments.

#FreelanceLife

Friday and I closed 3 tabs.

That's the whole productivity tip. Close the tabs. Focus on one thing.

Revolutionary.

#Productivity

Microphone upgrade was worth it.

Went from laptop mic to dedicated USB mic.

Clients actually comment on the audio quality now.

#RemoteWork

Weekend plans: absolutely nothing work-related.

The laptop stays closed.

This is a promise I'm making publicly for accountability.

#WorkLifeBalance

Digital nomad visa research continues.

Portugal and Spain both look good.

Leaning Portugal for the cost of living.

#DigitalNomad

Sunday evening planning.

Looked at the week ahead. 4 meetings. That's 3.5 too many.

Going to decline some tomorrow.

#Productivity

International payment tip: Wise beats PayPal on fees almost every time.

Just saying. Do the math on your next transfer.

#FreelanceLife

Started the week by turning off email notifications.

Will check twice a day.

The anxiety might kill me but the productivity won't.

#Productivity

Web hosting comparison dropping soon.

Tested for uptime, speed, and support.

Spoiler: support is where most fail.

#RemoteWork

Freelancer tax season approaching.

Already dreading it.

At least I tracked expenses better this year. Small wins.

#FreelanceLife

WiFi at this cafe is 3 Mbps.

That's technically internet. Barely.

Hotspot it is. Always have backup internet. Always.

#DigitalNomad

Notion vs alternatives debate continues.

Tried switching. Came back.

Some tools just work for your brain. Stop fighting it.

#Productivity

Retirement planning as a freelancer is terrifying.

No 401k match. No pension.

Just you and compound interest. Start early.

#FreelanceLife

Almost end of January.

Time moves faster when you work from home. Days blur together.

Calendar blocking helps.

#RemoteWork

Slack vs Teams vs Discord debate: they all work.

Pick the one your team already uses.

Tool wars are a waste of time.

#RemoteWork

Last day of January.

Made it through month one of 2026.

Still working remote. Still happy about it.

Onward to February.

#RemoteWork

Monthly review: shipped 3 articles, landed 2 clients, took weekends off.

Good month. Simple metrics, clear progress.

#Productivity
